name: Ayushman Bharat - Pradhan Mantri Jan Arogya Yojana (PM-JAY)
ministry: Ministry of Health and Family Welfare / NHA
benefit_summary: Cashless and paperless secondary and tertiary hospitalisation coverage of ₹5 Lakhs per family per year across 28,000+ empaneled public and private hospitals.
who_can_apply_intro: All eligible citizens who meet the Ayushman Bharat - Pradhan Mantri Jan Arogya Yojana (PM-JAY) guidelines.
required_documents: Ayushman Card / Golden Card (if already issued)
application_steps: Check that your Aadhaar card and active bank passbook are ready.
Visit the official portal or your local Common Service Centre (CSC) / Panchayat office.
Fill in the application details and complete your biometric or OTP e-KYC.
Receive your application reference number to track verification and direct payment status.
